tomato_early_blight.description: Fungal disease causing concentric brown spots on lower leaves, spreading upward.
tomato_early_blight.immediate_action: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves immediately.
tomato_early_blight.preventive_action: Rotate crops — avoid planting tomato/potato in the same spot next season.
tomato_early_blight.escalation_trigger: If more than 50% of the plant is affected, consult a local agriculture officer before further chemical use.

tomato_late_blight.description: Aggressive fungal-like disease (Phytophthora) causing dark, water-soaked lesions that spread rapidly in humid weather.
tomato_late_blight.immediate_action: Remove and burn/bury infected plants — do not compost.
tomato_late_blight.preventive_action: Avoid working in the field when leaves are wet to prevent spread.
tomato_late_blight.escalation_trigger: Late blight can destroy a field within days. Escalate to an expert if spread is rapid across multiple plants.

potato_early_blight.description: Fungal disease showing target-like brown spots on older potato leaves.
potato_early_blight.preventive_action: Practice 2-3 year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.
potato_early_blight.escalation_trigger: Monitor tubers at harvest for secondary infection.

potato_late_blight.description: Fast-spreading disease causing dark lesions on leaves and stems, especially in cool, wet weather.
potato_late_blight.immediate_action: Destroy infected plant material away from the field.
potato_late_blight.preventive_action: Harvest early if the disease is spreading fast to save remaining tubers.
potato_late_blight.escalation_trigger: This is the disease responsible for historic famine-level crop loss — treat as high priority.

maize_common_rust.description: Fungal disease producing reddish-brown pustules on maize leaves.
maize_common_rust.immediate_action: Apply fungicide (e.g. propiconazole) if infection is detected early in the season.
maize_common_rust.preventive_action: Monitor weekly during humid growing periods.
maize_common_rust.escalation_trigger: Usually manageable; escalate only if yield-bearing leaves are heavily damaged before tasseling.

maize_healthy.description: No disease symptoms detected on this maize sample.
maize_healthy.immediate_action: Continue regular monitoring, especially after rain.
maize_healthy.preventive_action: Maintain balanced irrigation and fertilization schedule.
maize_healthy.escalation_trigger: None — recheck if new symptoms appear.

tomato_healthy.description: No disease symptoms detected on this tomato sample.
tomato_healthy.immediate_action: Continue regular monitoring for early signs of blight.
tomato_healthy.escalation_trigger: None — recheck if new symptoms appear.

pepper_bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing small, dark, raised spots on pepper leaves and fruit.
pepper_bacterial_spot.immediate_action: Remove infected plant debris and avoid working with wet plants.
pepper_bacterial_spot.escalation_trigger: Bacterial spot does not respond to fungicides — use copper-based bactericides only.

lumpy_skin_disease.description: Viral disease in cattle causing firm skin nodules, fever, and reduced milk yield, spread by biting insects.
lumpy_skin_disease.immediate_action: Isolate the affected animal immediately from the herd.
lumpy_skin_disease.preventive_action: Disinfect shared equipment and water troughs.
lumpy_skin_disease.escalation_trigger: Notifiable disease in many regions — report to local veterinary authority.

foot_and_mouth_disease.description: Highly contagious viral disease causing fever, blisters on mouth/feet, and limping in cattle.
foot_and_mouth_disease.immediate_action: Isolate the animal and restrict herd movement immediately.
foot_and_mouth_disease.preventive_action: Do not sell or move animals until cleared by an official.
foot_and_mouth_disease.escalation_trigger: Reportable disease — contact veterinary authorities immediately, do not self-treat.

mastitis_suspected.description: Suspected udder inflammation, often from bacterial infection, reducing milk quality/yield.
mastitis_suspected.immediate_action: Milk the affected quarter separately and discard the milk.
mastitis_suspected.preventive_action: Check milking equipment hygiene to prevent spread to other animals.
mastitis_suspected.escalation_trigger: Untreated mastitis can become chronic — seek veterinary care promptly.

abnormal_temperature.description: Sensor detected temperature outside the normal range for cattle, combined with behavioural signs.
abnormal_temperature.immediate_action: Recheck temperature with a manual thermometer to confirm sensor reading.
abnormal_temperature.preventive_action: Contact a veterinarian if fever persists beyond 24 hours.
abnormal_temperature.escalation_trigger: Persistent high fever combined with low feed intake needs urgent veterinary attention.

healthy.description: No disease symptoms detected on this livestock sample.
healthy.escalation_trigger: None — recheck if new symptoms appear.

wheat_rust.description: Fungal disease causing orange/brown pustules on wheat leaves.
wheat_rust.immediate_action: Apply systemic fungicides (e.g. tebuconazole) at first sign.
wheat_rust.preventive_action: Use resistant wheat varieties in future.
wheat_rust.escalation_trigger: Can cause severe yield loss if not treated before heading.

rice_blast.description: Devastating fungal disease causing diamond-shaped lesions on rice leaves.

cotton_bollworm.description: Pest larvae that feed on cotton bolls, destroying the fiber.
cotton_bollworm.escalation_trigger: Pests can develop resistance; rotate chemicals.

poultry_avian_influenza.description: Highly contagious viral disease in poultry causing sudden death and respiratory distress.
poultry_avian_influenza.preventive_action: Implement strict biosecurity and cull infected birds.

poultry_newcastle_disease.description: Viral disease in birds causing twisting of the neck, paralysis, and drop in egg production.

goat_peste_des_petits_ruminants.description: Severe viral disease (PPR) of sheep and goats causing fever, sores in the mouth, and diarrhea.
goat_peste_des_petits_ruminants.preventive_action: Provide supportive care and antibiotics for secondary infections.
goat_peste_des_petits_ruminants.escalation_trigger: High mortality rate; notify vet services.

soybean_rust.description: Aggressive fungal disease causing premature defoliation in soybean.
soybean_rust.preventive_action: Ensure good canopy penetration of spray.

citrus_canker.description: Bacterial disease causing raised corky lesions on citrus leaves, stems, and fruit.

mango_anthracnose.description: Fungal disease causing dark irregular spots on leaves, blossoms, and fruits of mango.
mango_anthracnose.immediate_action: Apply fungicides during flowering and early fruit set.

crop_nitrogen_deficiency.description: Nutrient deficiency causing overall yellowing of older leaves and stunted growth.
crop_nitrogen_deficiency.immediate_action: Apply a nitrogen-rich fertilizer (e.g., urea) immediately.
crop_nitrogen_deficiency.preventive_action: Ensure soil moisture is adequate to allow nutrient uptake.
crop_nitrogen_deficiency.escalation_trigger: Prolonged deficiency will severely reduce yield.

crop_phosphorus_deficiency.description: Nutrient deficiency causing dark green leaves with purplish discoloration, especially on leaf edges.
crop_phosphorus_deficiency.immediate_action: Apply phosphorus-based fertilizer (e.g., DAP or superphosphate) near the root zone.
crop_phosphorus_deficiency.preventive_action: Check soil pH; high acidity or alkalinity can lock up phosphorus.
crop_phosphorus_deficiency.escalation_trigger: Can delay crop maturity and reduce root development.

livestock_heat_stress.description: Animal showing excessive panting, lethargy, and reduced feed intake due to high environmental temperatures.
livestock_heat_stress.immediate_action: Move the animal to a shaded, well-ventilated area immediately.
livestock_heat_stress.preventive_action: Spray the animal with cool water or use fans.
livestock_heat_stress.escalation_trigger: Severe heat stress can lead to fatal heat stroke. Monitor closely.

livestock_ketosis.description: Metabolic disorder usually occurring in high-yielding dairy cows shortly after calving, causing sweet-smelling breath and weight loss.
livestock_ketosis.immediate_action: Provide high-energy feed supplements (e.g., propylene glycol or molasses).
livestock_ketosis.preventive_action: Consult a veterinarian if the animal refuses to eat.
livestock_ketosis.escalation_trigger: Can lead to severe milk drop and liver damage if untreated.

banana_bunchy_top.description: Devastating viral disease causing stunted growth and bunching of leaves at the top of the banana plant.
banana_bunchy_top.immediate_action: Uproot and completely destroy the infected plant to prevent spread.
banana_bunchy_top.preventive_action: Use certified virus-free planting material in the future.
banana_bunchy_top.escalation_trigger: Highly infectious and cannot be cured. Eradicate infected plants immediately.

crop_healthy.description: No disease symptoms detected on the photographed leaf.
crop_healthy.preventive_action: Continue routine weekly scouting, crop rotation and balanced fertilisation.
crop_healthy.escalation_trigger: None — recheck if new symptoms appear.
